description: Find the resumes of the user's resume database closest to a job, by proximity only: application_ids with a similarity between 0 and 1, best first, and whether each is already scored for the job. No evaluation: pass the ones worth it to score_resumes. Give the job as the job_id of a stored job or as job_text (at least 30 characters; the job is then stored). Costs 1 HireLayer credit per search.

added_after.description: Keep the resumes added after this date (ISO 8601).

city.description: Keep the resumes located around this city. Resumes without a known location are left out.

country_code.description: The city's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 such as FR.

job_id.description: A stored job. Give job_id or job_text.

job_text.description: A job description not stored yet, at least 30 characters.

limit.description: How many resumes to return, 50 by default.

radius_km.description: Around the city, 30 km by default.

workspace.description: The client company this call belongs to, when the user recruits for several companies: its HireLayer workspace id (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters), e.g. acme-corp. Jobs, resumes and scores stay apart from other clients'. A new id creates a new workspace, so reuse the exact id. Omit it for the user's default workspace.

name: search_resumes
title: Talent Pool Search
